script exec("import os, socket, subprocess, time
support = lldb.SBHostOS.GetLLDBPath(lldb.ePathTypeSupportExecutableDir)
debugserver_path = os.path.join(support.GetDirectory() or '', support.GetFilename() or '', 'debugserver')
port_socket = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
port_socket.settimeout(30)
port_socket.bind("/var/folders/60/fkw4vxts4p1g7rvpdh06k19r0000gn/T/tint-a3-self-fKJvWe/port")
port_socket.listen(1)
debugserver_output = open("/var/folders/60/fkw4vxts4p1g7rvpdh06k19r0000gn/T/tint-a3-self-fKJvWe/debugserver.log", 'wb')
debugserver = subprocess.Popen([debugserver_path] + ["--kill-on-error","--no-stdio","--unix-socket","/var/folders/60/fkw4vxts4p1g7rvpdh06k19r0000gn/T/tint-a3-self-fKJvWe/port","--","127.0.0.1:0","/Users/stephenbelanger/.t3/worktrees/tint/t3-c0227322/.tint-bootstrap/a3/selfbuild-shadow-v31/stage1","/Users/stephenbelanger/.t3/worktrees/tint/t3-c0227322/.tint-bootstrap/a3/selfbuild-shadow-v31/sources","/Users/stephenbelanger/.t3/worktrees/tint/t3-c0227322/.tint-bootstrap/a3/selfbuild-shadow-v31/stage2","--debug-symbols"], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=debugserver_output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
open("/var/folders/60/fkw4vxts4p1g7rvpdh06k19r0000gn/T/tint-a3-self-fKJvWe/debugserver-pid", 'w').write(str(debugserver.pid))
port_connection, _ = port_socket.accept()
port_connection.settimeout(30)
port_parts = []
while True:
    part = port_connection.recv(64)
    if not part: break
    port_parts.append(part)
port_connection.close()
port_socket.close()
port = int(b''.join(port_parts).decode('ascii'))
assert 0 < port <= 65535
connection_result = lldb.SBCommandReturnObject()
lldb.debugger.GetCommandInterpreter().HandleCommand('gdb-remote 127.0.0.1:' + str(port), connection_result)
open("/var/folders/60/fkw4vxts4p1g7rvpdh06k19r0000gn/T/tint-a3-self-fKJvWe/connection.log", 'w').write((connection_result.GetOutput() or '') + (connection_result.GetError() or ''))
assert connection_result.Succeeded(), connection_result.GetError()")

script exec("import json
p=lldb.debugger.GetSelectedTarget().GetProcess()
open("/Users/stephenbelanger/.t3/worktrees/tint/t3-c0227322/.tint-bootstrap/a3/selfbuild-shadow-v31/selfbuild-initial.json",'w').write(json.dumps({'state':p.GetState(),'pid':p.GetProcessID()}))
assert p.GetState()==lldb.eStateStopped and p.GetProcessID()>0
p.Continue()
open("/Users/stephenbelanger/.t3/worktrees/tint/t3-c0227322/.tint-bootstrap/a3/selfbuild-shadow-v31/selfbuild-outcome.json",'w').write(json.dumps({'state':p.GetState(),'exitStatus':p.GetExitStatus(),'pid':p.GetProcessID()}))
assert p.GetState()==lldb.eStateExited and p.GetExitStatus()==0")
